Name: Petting Checker
Author: PureWinter
Description:
This mod shows a gray heart above animals that have not been pet that day, and red hearts for those that have, until all animals on the main farm have been pet. Then the hearts dissapear for that day.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pHnzK1f.png[/img]

Requires SMAPI

I made this for testing my staff mod to ensure the animal tender WAS actually petting the animals like I was paying him to do, lol.
